# A Thousand Plateaus reader

> A reading interface by Andrew Culp for plateaus 12 and 13 of Deleuze and Guattari's A Thousand Plateaus. Each chunk shows the Minuit French, Brian Massumi's Minnesota English and an annotated translation, lined up sentence by sentence, with Massumi's endnotes, short glosses after French words, a lexicon of terms, search and page jump. The page is built with JavaScript.

The annotated translation, glosses and lexicon were drafted with machine assistance and have not all been reviewed.

## Pages

- [A Thousand Plateaus reader: Treatise on Nomadology and Apparatus of Capture in French and English](https://minor-science.github.io/thousand-plateaus-reader/reader.html): Plateaus 12 and 13 of A Thousand Plateaus in the Minuit French and Massumi's English, sentence by sentence beside an annotated translation, with glosses, endnotes and a lexicon.
